Six comments

Joshua’s Dream (Aisling Yoshua)

From the title track of Johnny Og Connolly’s wonderful CD. Composed by Johnny for his young nephew. I tried to transcribe it as Johnny plays it first time through. If I missed (or worse, added) anything, please let me know! It’s a fairly complex tune transcribed straight through without trying to deal with repeats and second endings. The high bits in the B part can be moved down an octave without spoiling the tune, but I’ll leave that to other to work out.

↳ Posted by billwolfe on June 5th, 2017.
